verdict.rationale: Rollbar docs confirm multi-channel notification routing (email, Slack, PagerDuty, arbitrary webhooks) which supports the destination side of the story, and item filtering by environment/severity is shown in the API reference (e.g., filtering items by 'error or critical' in 'production'). However, there is no direct evidence of configurable per-rule alert thresholds for specific trigger types like new issue, frequency spike, or affected-user count — the docs describe general 'real-time alerts' rather than granular rule-based routing logic. missing for 10: explicit documentation of threshold-based alert rules (new-issue, frequency-spike, affected-user-count triggers) and confirmation that routing can be scoped per project/environment/severity combination.
